focus: Decode the Jev score, paired comparator, keep gates, and sample limitations.
noveltyJustification: First research pass for this lineage; mapped all reported score fields to scorer calculations and established the constructed/live sample split and exact keep-gate arithmetic.
keyQuestions: What in the scorer, sample, and paired comparison drove the recorded result, and what does it not establish?
answeredQuestions: The displayed counts all pass the fixed keep gates; 22 paired wins and zero losses yield p=2.384e-7 on this sample.
The 40 rows are 20 live and 20 constructed moved-window cases, so the result is not a production prevalence estimate.
Citation resolution and semantic claim support are distinct checks.
ruledOut: Reading F=3 as three incorrect gold labels or three flipped rows; the scorer counts dissenting rerun votes.
Treating the paired sign-test p-value as an estimate of generalization beyond this fixed sample.
nextFocus: Research accuracy and cost improvements, label/sample trustworthiness, and semantic checks elsewhere in .skilled.

title: Strong paired result on the measured sample
finding: Jev was correct on 35/40 rows against the stronger baseline's 13/40, with 22 paired wins, zero losses, 18 ties, precision 1.0, and an exact one-sided sign-test p-value of 2.384e-7.
inference: 18 ties and implied 9 TN/5 FN are algebraically derived from the recorded totals and scorer definitions; raw call/label rows would independently confirm them.

title: Half the benchmark is constructed drift
finding: The 40-row set contains 20 live citations and 20 constructed contradictory cases made by moving the window 60 lines in the same file; it is a fixed benchmark, not a sample of production citation prevalence.
inference: Performance on this balanced sample may not transfer to ordinary drift rates or other claim types; a representative holdout would confirm external validity.

title: F is dissenting rerun votes
finding: F=3 counts votes that differ from each row's modal flag; with 40 rows and three calls per row it is 3/120=2.5%, below the scorer's 10% cap, and does not mean three mislabeled or flipped rows.
inference: The total 120 measured rerun votes is computed as 3*M; per-row call records could verify the exact dissent allocation.

title: Keep structural resolution separate from semantic support
finding: The default scan resolves tracked path:line references with zero model calls; Jev separately judges whether the cited window still supports the prose claim.
inference: The two outputs should remain separate so semantic uncertainty does not weaken exhaustive deterministic dead-citation reporting.
